assertions.name: no_hardcoded_registry_matches
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no script hardcodes a registry value without acknowledged-anchor banner)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every numerical literal in production scripts is either symbolic (q_0 powers, integer coefficients), imported from codata_constants, below the magnitude window, or in a script that carries the CLASS-A acknowledged-anchor banner.

description: I9 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: scripts that hardcode a numerical literal matching a registered constant in codata_constants.py (within 1e-3 relative error) without importing the corresponding symbol.  Bypassing the registry decouples the script from the canonical source of truth — if CODATA updates, the literal silently drifts.  Tolerance is permissive (1e-3) to catch loose rounding like `0.511` matching M_E_MEV = 0.51099895.
